mapper.sql: FROM review_task_run r INNER JOIN review_task t ON t.task_id = r.task_id INNER JOIN review_project p ON p.project_id = t.project_id INNER JOIN sys_business_system bs ON bs.system_id = p.business_system_id INNER JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = p.dept_id INNER JOIN sys_user owner ON owner.user_id = p.owner_user_id
mapper.select:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.input_tokens), 0) AS inputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(r.output_tokens), 0) AS outputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(r.total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, SUM(CASE WHEN r.total_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS callCount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.run_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.run_status = 'SUCCESS' AND r.total_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successMissingTokens
WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT DATE(r.create_time) AS date, COALESCE(SUM(r.input_tokens), 0) AS inputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(r.output_tokens), 0) AS outputTokens
WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY DATE(r.create_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT r.snapshot_model_id AS modelId, COALESCE(MAX(r.snapshot_model_name), '未命名模型') AS modelName, MAX(r.snapshot_model_provider) AS provider, SUM(CASE WHEN r.total_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS callCount, COALESCE(SUM(r.input_tokens), 0) AS inputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(r.output_tokens), 0) AS outputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(r.total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens
WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY r.snapshot_model_id HAVING callCount > 0 ORDER BY totalTokens DESC

SELECT r.snapshot_model_id AS modelId, COALESCE(MAX(r.snapshot_model_name), '未命名模型') AS modelName, MAX(r.snapshot_model_provider) AS provider
WHERE r.snapshot_model_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.snapshot_model_id ORDER BY modelName ASC

SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, p.project_name AS projectName, bs.system_name AS businessSystemName, owner.nick_name AS ownerName, SUM(CASE WHEN r.total_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS callCount, COALESCE(SUM(r.total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(r.input_tokens), 0) AS inputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(r.output_tokens), 0) AS outputTokens
WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY p.project_id, p.project_name, bs.system_name, owner.nick_name HAVING callCount > 0 ORDER BY totalTokens DESC

SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, r.snapshot_model_id AS modelId, COALESCE(SUM(r.input_tokens), 0) AS inputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(r.output_tokens), 0) AS outputTokens
WHERE r.total_tokens IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.project_id, r.snapshot_model_id

SELECT r.run_id AS runId, r.task_id AS taskId, p.project_name AS projectName, p.project_id AS projectId, r.snapshot_model_id AS modelId, r.snapshot_model_name AS modelName, r.snapshot_review_mode AS reviewMode, r.create_time AS triggerTime, r.input_tokens AS inputTokens, r.output_tokens AS outputTokens, r.total_tokens AS totalTokens
WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY r.create_time DESC, r.run_id DESC
